title: The Intelligence Bound: Reference Computations
description:
Working paper, not peer reviewed.

Reference computations and supplementary materials for "The Intelligence Bound: Thermodynamic Limits on Learning Rate and Implications for Biosphere Information" (Hart 2025). The code evaluates the conjectured bound min(D*B, P/(k_B T ln 2)) for illustrative inputs and reproduces the paper's tables; it does not test the bound against measured learning rates. The physical bound is a conjecture; its conditional mathematics is checked in Lean 4 in intelligence-bound-lean, where the thermodynamic arm is an assumed premise.

Authorship and AI use. Justin D. Hart (Viridis LLC, ORCID 0009-0008-3082-2482) is the accountable author. Claude (Anthropic) was used to audit the code and correct the documentation.
